notes:
# v1.4.14 - Liquid Glass overhaul and a faster Home

- New: the bottom tab bar is now a floating Liquid Glass bar. It sits inset from
  the screen edges, is fully rounded, and is translucent, so the page stays
  visible and keeps scrolling beneath it instead of stopping above an opaque
  slab. On wide screens it keeps the floating sidebar shape.
- New: the glass surfaces use a four-layer material - a blurred backdrop that
  also refracts the rim, a neutral scrim, a Fresnel rim that catches light along
  the top and bottom edges, and a fine grain that breaks up banding.
- Improved: pressing the tab bar now gives immediate feedback - the surface
  flexes slightly and a soft highlight blooms from the point you touched. With a
  mouse or trackpad the specular highlight also follows the pointer along the
  bar; on touch it stays put so scrolling never has to repaint it.
- Improved: the glass adapts to your device settings. With Reduce Transparency
  on, surfaces become frostier and more opaque; with Reduce Motion on, the press
  scale and bloom are dropped; on devices without backdrop blur, surfaces fall
  back to a solid, readable panel. On touch devices the rim refraction is
  skipped to keep scrolling smooth, while the blur stays.
- Improved: Home loads faster. Each row now shows a limited number of cards
  instead of every result at once, and "View All" opens the full list.
- Improved: listing responses are smaller, so Home loads faster on slow
  connections.
- Improved: repeat launches are near-instant - bundled app files are kept on
  your device instead of being re-checked every launch, while updates are still
  checked each launch.
- Improved: scrolling rows and the reader feel smoother - sideways row scrolling
  and chapter restore no longer repeat unnecessary layout work every frame, and
  the reader updates its progress bar only when the percentage actually changes.
- Improved: Home, the rankings tabs and recommendations now share one
  calculation per library change instead of repeating it for each row, and
  duplicate background requests are shared instead of fired twice.
- Fixed: the reader toolbar and the tab bar now keep their contents laid out
  correctly after the glass rework, so the brand, links and reader controls no
  longer stack as blocks.
- Note: the classic dark and light themes are unchanged - the new material only
  applies to the App Store glass themes.
- Note: no action needed - just update.
